channel.title: The Grant Desk - Grants, AI, Tech & Research, Remote & Worldwide, weekly digest
channel.description: Paid open calls, fellowships and residencies in AI, tech, research, and digital and mixed-media arts, sorted into the right pile. Updated as new calls land on the desk. Filtered to: Grants, AI, Tech & Research, Remote & Worldwide, weekly digest. Released weekly: the week's new grants arrive together on Sunday, one entry per grant plus a short roundup header, instead of trickling out daily.

item.title: 3 new AI, Tech & Research grants - week of 24 Aug 2026
item.description:
• Rory Peck Trust: Crisis Fund for Freelance Journalists
    https://rorypecktrust.org/get-help/crisis/crisis-fund/
    Rory Peck Trust · deadline Rolling / undated · Individual emergency grants; amounts are set case by case from an assessment of circumstances and need. No application fee.
  • IIE Scholar Rescue Fund (IIE-SRF) Fellowship for Threatened and Displaced Scholars
    https://www.iie.org/programs/scholar-rescue-fund/for-scholars/
    Institute of International Education (IIE), Scholar Rescue Fund · deadline Rolling / undated · Fellowship of up to USD 30,000 for one year, paid towards a temporary academic position at a host institution; in most cases renewable for a second and final year. No application fee.
  • Digital Defenders Partnership: Incident Response Fund
    https://www.digitaldefenders.org/funds/
    Digital Defenders Partnership (DDP), hosted by Hivos · deadline Rolling / undated · Rapid-response grants of up to USD 5,000 (historically up to EUR 10,000) for costs that directly reduce the risk or impact of a digital attack, covering activities for a maximum of four months. No application fee.

Full listing with filters: The Grant Desk (https://www.artificialnouveau.com/smalltools/grants/).

item.title: 2 new AI, Tech & Research grants - week of 15 Jun 2026
item.description:
• Longview Philanthropy: Digital Minds Grants for Applied Work 2026
    https://www.longview.org/request-for-proposals-research-and-applied-work-on-digital-minds/
    Longview Philanthropy · deadline Closed 10 Jul 2026 · Typical grants $50,000–$2,000,000 per project; proposals outside this range considered when the work justifies it. May include some operational support for new organisations. No application fee.
  • Scaling AI Safety for a Multi-Agent World (Joint Funding Call)
    https://schmidtsciences.smapply.io/prog/scaling_ai_safety_for_a_multi_agent_world/
    Schmidt Sciences, Google DeepMind, the Advanced Research & Invention Agency (ARIA), the Cooperative AI Foundation, and Google.org · deadline Closed 08 Aug 2026 · Two funding tiers (applicants may apply to either or both), projects 1 to 2 years. Tier 1: up to USD 300,000 for exploratory research, pilot studies, or focused technical investigations. Tier 2: USD 300,000 to USD 1,000,000 for more ambitious or collaborative projects. For projects funded by Schmidt Sciences, indirect costs must be at or below 10%. No application fee.

Full listing with filters: The Grant Desk (https://www.artificialnouveau.com/smalltools/grants/).

item.title: 3 new AI, Tech & Research grants - week of 18 May 2026
item.description:
• SSRC: Innovation in Religion and Spirituality Seed Grants 2026
    https://www.ssrc.org/programs/religion-and-the-public-sphere/innovation-in-religion-and-spirituality-seed-grants/
    Social Science Research Council (SSRC) - Religion and the Public Sphere program, with support from the Luce Foundation, the John Templeton Foundation, and the Templeton World Charity Foundation · deadline Closed 01 Jul 2026 · Up to USD 10,000 per award. Funds may cover travel and accommodation, research equipment and supplies, research assistants, and access to publications or proprietary databases (other uses possible in exceptional cases, in consultation with programme staff). No application fee.
  • Long-Term Future Fund (EA Funds)
    https://funds.effectivealtruism.org/funds/far-future
    Effective Altruism Funds · deadline Rolling / undated · Individual stipends and project grants, typically ~$2,500 to $120,000+ (recent average around $38,000 per grant). No application fee.
  • Pulitzer Center: Global Reporting Grants
    https://pulitzercenter.org/grant-application
    Pulitzer Center · deadline Rolling / undated · Most awards $5,000 to $10,000 per project, covering reporting hard costs (typically no salaries or equipment). No application fee.

Full listing with filters: The Grant Desk (https://www.artificialnouveau.com/smalltools/grants/).

item.title: 3 new AI, Tech & Research grants - week of 11 May 2026
item.description:
• Survival and Flourishing Fund (SFF): 2026 Themed Rounds (Climate, Animal Welfare, HSEE)
    https://survivalandflourishing.fund/2026/application
    Survival and Flourishing Fund (SFF), backed by Jaan Tallinn · deadline Closed 10 Jun 2026 · Total USD 20-40M expected across all 2026 SFF rounds. Individual grants typically range from tens of thousands of USD to low millions. Remaining 2026 themed-round deadlines: Climate Theme 10 June; Climate Speculation and Animal Welfare Theme 24 June; Animal Welfare Speculation and HSEE Theme 8 July; HSEE Speculation 22 July (HSEE = Human Self-Empowerment and Existential Risk).
  • Wikimedia Conference Fund
    https://meta.wikimedia.org/wiki/Grants:Conference
    Wikimedia Foundation · deadline Closed 31 Aug 2026 · From USD 10,000 per grant (no preset upper cap stated). No application fee.
  • Wenner-Gren Foundation: Post-PhD Research Grant (November 2026 cycle)
    https://wennergren.org/program/post-phd-research-grant/
